## Change request

<!-- e.g. CR-DIDAS-0003: Short title -->

Discussion issue: #

Steward:

## Author checklist

- [ ] File named `proposals/CR-DIDAS-NNNN-short-title.md` with the next free number
- [ ] Front matter filled in, including aspects and sectors
- [ ] Problem described from the perspective of the actors affected
- [ ] Requested outcome stated without prescribing a technical solution
- [ ] Every statement about swiyu checked against the current specification or code and referenced with a commit-pinned link
- [ ] *Sources* table filled in
- [ ] Facts, assessments and open questions kept apart
- [ ] Evidence from use cases, trust flows or deployments linked
- [ ] Row added to `proposals/README.md` and a file to `changelog/`
- [ ] Relevant interests disclosed

## Governance gates

Do not merge until all are ticked. See GOVERNANCE.md.

- [ ] Steward confirms the change request is ready for consultation
- [ ] Working groups of the affected sectors named in the *Governance* table and notified
- [ ] Consultation of at least 14 days completed
- [ ] Every consulted working group has stated a position
- [ ] *Community input* written, including dissent
- [ ] Sources re-checked against the current specification
- [ ] Council decisions recorded as endorsed, with date and link
- [ ] Several sectors: positions consolidated by DIDAS; escalation to the Steering Circle recorded if any
- [ ] Status set to *Endorsed* in the change request and the index
